purpose: Market-structure pilot before selecting an FX strategy. No entry rule, SL/TP optimisation, 50% claim or promotion.
cost_semantics: Request spread=0 selects observed sampled spread; commission=0 means unknown/excluded for this diagnostic, NOT zero-cost trading. 48bp RT plus observed spread is reserve excluding commission. No alternate 1/3bp scenario is scored.

sources.title: BIS 2025 survey
sources.use_and_limit: Global OTC FX turnover and currency concentration; not broker-specific volume or a directional signal.

sources.title: Neely and Weller, Intraday Technical Trading in the Foreign Exchange Market
sources.use_and_limit: Tested technical rules lacked excess returns after realistic costs/hours. Historical sample does not prove all modern strategies fail.

sources.title: Breedon and Ranaldo, Intraday Patterns in FX Returns and Order Flow
sources.use_and_limit: Published abstract supports time-of-day/order-flow effects. Full paper not retrieved; no modern net profitability or identical cTrader execution asserted.

sources.title: Andersen et al., Micro Effects of Macro Announcements
sources.use_and_limit: Surprises versus expectations cause conditional mean jumps; a calendar alone is not a direction predictor.

sources.title: Menkhoff et al., Currency Momentum Strategies
sources.use_and_limit: Cross-sectional momentum evidence, costs and limits to arbitrage. Does not validate a four-hour opening-range breakout.

sources.title: BIS, FX execution algorithms and market functioning
sources.use_and_limit: Fragmented liquidity and execution risk require suitable data and transaction-cost measurement.

sources.title: Pepperstone costs and fees
sources.use_and_limit: Account/platform-specific spread, commission and NY-close funding. Public page entity may differ from owner; current generic wording is not historical account calibration.

sources.title: FX Global Code
sources.use_and_limit: Good execution, disclosure and risk practices; no return forecast or strategy validation.

limitations: Two dates only: operational/coverage pilot, not representative weekday/regime sample or selection/validation set.
No economic-event labels, historical consensus vintages, order flow, depth or certified fill costs.
Range is observed hindsight, not capturable profit. Tick counts are quote activity, not market volume.
Compare per pair/window only; seven USD pairs are correlated, not independent bets.
All data precede the research seal. Do not reuse these dates as untouched validation.
next_gates: Confirm exact symbol, quote quality, units, commission conversion and costs per account.
Acquire as-of event timing/consensus and broader session/regime history; do not retrospectively relabel using revised data.
Choose one economically motivated FX hypothesis, freeze controls/cost scenarios/splits before outcomes.
Replay costs/latency/gaps and compare no-skill/unchanged-rule controls. Preserve failed trials.
Separate-time validation per instrument with uncertainty, net expectancy/PF and adequate samples; interim >=50% alone insufficient.
Demo shadow qualification and portfolio USD exposure/margin checks before any proposed live strategy change.
